title: OPNsense / WAN - IPv4 vs IPv6
description: WAN traffic split by IP family, from the pf per-interface byte and packet counters. Supports several WANs at once.

list.name: wan
list.label: WAN (pf interfaces)
list.description: pf names of the WAN interfaces, e.g. igb0 or pppoe0. Select every uplink (BGP / multi-WAN): the panels add them up, and Per WAN breaks them down.

panels.title: Download now
panels.description: IPv4 + IPv6 traffic allowed in on the selected WANs, last rate interval. With several WANs selected, every panel shows their sum; see Per WAN for the breakdown.

panels.title: Upload now
panels.description: IPv4 + IPv6 traffic allowed out of the selected WANs, last rate interval. With several WANs selected, every panel shows their sum; see Per WAN for the breakdown.

panels.title: IPv6 share of download
panels.description: IPv6 bytes / all IP bytes downloaded over the selected time range.

panels.title: IPv6 share of upload
panels.description: IPv6 bytes / all IP bytes uploaded over the selected time range.

panels.title: Downloaded in range
panels.description: Bytes downloaded per IP family over the selected time range.

panels.title: Uploaded in range
panels.description: Bytes uploaded per IP family over the selected time range.

panels.title: Download by family
panels.description: Traffic allowed in on the selected WANs, stacked by IP family.

panels.title: Upload by family
panels.description: Traffic allowed out of the selected WANs, stacked by IP family.

panels.title: IPv6 share over time
panels.description: Fraction of the WAN bytes carried over IPv6.

panels.title: IP traffic vs. interface counters
panels.description: pf per-family bytes compared with the NIC byte counters. The gap is blocked traffic, non-IP frames and link-layer overhead.

panels.title: Download per WAN
panels.description: IPv4 + IPv6 traffic allowed in, stacked by WAN.

panels.title: Upload per WAN
panels.description: IPv4 + IPv6 traffic allowed out, stacked by WAN.

panels.title: IPv6 share of download per WAN
panels.description: Fraction of each WAN's download carried over IPv6.

targets.expr: sum by (interface) (rate(opnsense_firewall_in_ipv6_pass_bytes_total{opnsense_instance="$instance", interface=~"$wan"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by (interface) (rate(opnsense_firewall_in_ipv4_pass_bytes_total{opnsense_instance="$instance", interface=~"$wan"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (interface) (rate(opnsense_firewall_in_ipv6_pass_bytes_total{opnsense_instance="$instance", interface=~"$wan"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Per WAN in range
panels.description: Bytes per WAN and IP family over the selected time range.

targets.expr: sum by (interface) (increase(opnsense_firewall_in_ipv6_pass_bytes_total{opnsense_instance="$instance", interface=~"$wan"}[$__range])) / (sum by (interface) (increase(opnsense_firewall_in_ipv4_pass_bytes_total{opnsense_instance="$instance", interface=~"$wan"}[$__range])) + sum by (interface) (increase(opnsense_firewall_in_ipv6_pass_bytes_total{opnsense_instance="$instance", interface=~"$wan"}[$__range])))

sum by (interface) (increase(opnsense_firewall_out_ipv6_pass_bytes_total{opnsense_instance="$instance", interface=~"$wan"}[$__range])) / (sum by (interface) (increase(opnsense_firewall_out_ipv4_pass_bytes_total{opnsense_instance="$instance", interface=~"$wan"}[$__range])) + sum by (interface) (increase(opnsense_firewall_out_ipv6_pass_bytes_total{opnsense_instance="$instance", interface=~"$wan"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Downloaded per day
panels.description: Bytes downloaded per IP family in the 24 h ending at each point.

panels.title: Uploaded per day
panels.description: Bytes uploaded per IP family in the 24 h ending at each point.

panels.title: Packets by family
panels.description: Allowed packets per second. Outbound is drawn below zero.

panels.title: Average packet size
panels.description: Bytes per allowed packet. Large values mean bulk transfers, small ones interactive or ACK traffic.

panels.title: Blocked inbound
panels.description: Packets blocked by the firewall on the selected WANs, inbound.

panels.title: Blocked bytes
panels.description: Traffic blocked by the firewall on the selected WANs.

panels.title: Blocked in range
panels.description: Blocked packets over the selected time range.
